Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept set narrowed, as declared — right.** Four leaves `approvalsInbox.rawData`, `approvalsInbox.copy`, `approvalsInbox.copied`, `approvalsInbox.copyFailed` leave all ten packs: the ten hunks are the same four-line deletion at the same position (after `viaOverrideHint`, before `overrideActor`) in ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru and zh. `TranslationKeys` is `typeof en` (`packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts`, re-exported from `packages/i18n/src/index.ts`), so the exported `en` pack and that type lose exactly those four members. The deletion is what ruling `6232118266` orders and what the card's pointer `6232139151` and claim `6245586356` re-point the card to: the side sheet's panel goes rather than being ported, and the keys only that panel read go with it.
2. **No reader of the four keys survives — right, re-derived here.** At the head, `git grep` for the spellings `approvalsInbox.(rawData|copy|copied|copyFailed)` over the whole tree hits only the changeset's prose; literal `tr(` / `t(` calls with the leaves `rawData`, `copy`, `copied`, `copyFailed` count zero in `apps/` and `packages/`. At the base the same census finds exactly four, all inside the deleted block of `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`. The template forwarders over the namespace (`approvalsInbox.${key}`) are the page's `tr`, `RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx`'s `tr`, and three test helpers (`RecordApprovalsPanel.eligibleApprovers-12781.test.tsx`, `ApprovalDecisionPanel.eligibleApprovers-12781.test.tsx`, `DecisionProgressIndicator.test.tsx`); none passes one of the four leaves. The other literal `approvalsInbox.*` readers in app-shell (`DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`, `ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx`, `DecisionProgressIndicator.tsx`, `RecordPreviewCard.tsx`, `approverIdentity.ts`) read other leaves. Same-leaf keys in other namespaces (`organization.invitations.copyFailed`, `engine.studio.if.copyFailed`) are untouched, as the changeset says. No `TranslationKeys[...]` indexer exists in `apps/` or `packages/`, so the type narrowing has no in-repo consumer left; the host-side consequence is stated in the changeset body.
3. **The gate farm cannot see this, and the PR says so — right.** `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` declares `head: 'approvalsInbox.'` with `enumerable: false`, `why: 'open-forwarder'` in `DYNAMIC_KEY_FAMILIES`, so `check:i18n-dead-keys` reads every leaf of the namespace as live before and after; the hand census in item 2 is the instrument, not the gate, and the PR body records it as such rather than citing the gate's green. `check:i18n-en-drift.mjs` states that an added or removed `en` key is not its business, and `all-locales-key-parity` holds by construction when all ten packs lose the same four keys.
4. **Nothing widens — right.** No `package.json` publish-contract field moves (`packages/i18n/package.json` and `apps/console/package.json` are not in the diff); no new export, key, prop, node type or registration; the new test file publishes nothing. `product-specific.allowlist.json` carries no `approvalsInbox` entry, so the product-neutral ratchet has nothing to delete here.
5. **The page deletion is complete and nothing else moves — right.** `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` loses the collapsed raw-data block (`details`/`summary`, the Copy button, the `pre`), `maySeeRawPayload` with its docblock, and the three imports only they used (`usePermissions`, `Copy`, `holdsStudioAccess`). At the head the page has zero occurrences of `maySeeRawPayload`, `holdsStudioAccess`, `usePermissions`, `systemPermissions`, `clipboard`, `studio.access`, a `pre` or a `details` element; `toast` (13 with its import) and `selected.payload` (5) keep other readers; every neighbouring import still has consumers. `holdsStudioAccess` is unchanged in `apps/console/src/components/studioEntry.ts` (no diff against `main`), still read by `StudioRoute.tsx` and pinned by `StudioRoute.test.tsx`. No file outside the card's surface changes.
6. **The absence pin is load-bearing — right, by construction.** The `studio.access` row renders with `systemPermissions: ['studio.access']` and a non-null payload. If the panel returned gated as it was, the old condition (`maySeeRawPayload && selected.payload != null`) would be true for that row: the `summary` would render `tr('rawData', 'Raw data (JSON)')`, which the test's i18n mock resolves to its `defaultValue`, exactly `PANEL_LABEL`; the `pre` would exist and carry both witnesses. All four assertions of `expectNoRawPayloadPanel` would then fail on that row, and the other three rows (setup.access, reported-empty, unreported) would go red only on an ungated return — the objectui#5553 leak. The witnesses are exact: `created_by` and `organization_id` are members of `SYSTEM_MANAGED_FIELD_NAMES` in `packages/types/src/system-fields.ts`, so the page's `isBookkeepingKey` drops them from the summary card and they could reach the DOM only through a raw dump. The counter-probe (`'Purchase Approval'`, `'Q3 clinical supplies'`) refuses an empty render. The harness is the retired pin's own (same four `vi.mock` targets, same `permissionsPayload` with the `undefined`-stays-absent rule, same `renderDrawerFor` / `openedDrawer`), so the git rename reads as a conversion, not a new suite. The dev's reported ablation (base blob restored: 1 failed on the `studio.access` row, 3 passed) agrees with this reading; it was not re-run here.
7. **Sibling tests change prose only — right.** The hunks in `hiddenFieldTrim`, `summaryFaces-11677` and `deadlineSettled-11815` touch header comments and one fixture comment; no assertion, fixture value or import changes.
8. **Served page untouched — right.** Nothing in the diff reaches objectstack's `plugin-approvals` page, and the card's original steps 2–4 are void per its re-pointed body (`record:json` retired by objectstack-ai/objectstack#24162).
9. **Check-runs on the head, read 2026-10-18T04:50Z:** 35 runs; 19 `success` (Build & E2E, Build Docs, Bundle Analysis, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Claim Re-read, Changeset Declaration, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Overwrite Report, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Line Citation Gate, Lint, Live E2E (informational), Repo Gates, Test (dist pins), Test shards 4/16, 12/16, 13/16, 16/16, label); 3 `skipped` (dependabot, Test (coverage), the coverage-shard template row); 13 `in_progress` (Test shards 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 14, 15 of 16, and Type Check); none `failure`. Not waited on; the landing seat reads the remainder.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/12490-drop-raw-payload-panel.md` declares `'@object-ui/console': patch` and `'@object-ui/i18n': minor`, the two released packages whose `src/` the diff touches (Changeset Declaration: `success`). Both sit in the one `fixed` group of `.changeset/config.json` (40 members), which bumps to its highest entry, so the release outcome is `minor` whichever way console is scored.
- **`@object-ui/i18n` minor — right.** Retiring members of the exported `en` pack and of `TranslationKeys` is BREAKING for a typed caller; under objectui's `AGENTS.md` §9 「版本号策略」 objectui's own breaking changes take `minor`, never `major` (Changeset Bump Policy: `success`; no `major` declared). The changeset says BREAKING and carries the migration (a host calling `t()` with a retired key gets the key back; supply the string from its own resources).
- **`@object-ui/console` patch — right.** The console's published contract (`exports` → `plugin.ts`) does not move; what goes is a non-business affordance inside the app, deleted on the maintainer's ruling; no authorable key or programmatic surface is removed. The ADR-0087 marker is an objectstack `packages/spec` rule and is not owed on an objectui changeset.
- **`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` — right.** Written at the start of a line in both the PR body and the changeset body, naming the four keys; the `(narrowing)` arm on either carrier is what makes this face owed (objectstack `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs`, `reviewFace`), and the diff declares nothing that widens, so `no` is the correct polarity.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev reported `open_questions: []`; four Acceptance notes and eight deviations, each answered:

1. `apps/console/src/pages/system/hiddenFields.ts` keeps "Contrast objectui#5553's raw-JSON panel, which fails CLOSED" in the present tense — confirmed at the head. Outside the claim's surface; a same-file comment, no gate reads it. Accepted as left; reword to the past tense when that file is next touched.
2. `scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs`'s `approvalsInbox.` family reason says "(169 keys)" — confirmed at the head; a stale count that predates this PR (an `AGENTS.md` #9 instance). Accepted as left; when repaired, replace the figure with a pointer to the dead-keys report, not a new figure.
3. `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.test.tsx` carries `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx:2014` and `:2055` — confirmed; a pre-existing cross-file line address, the banned form, not swept per rule #11; the differential Line Citation Gate reads `success` on this head. Accepted.
4. No negative `packages/i18n` pin for the four retired keys (earlier batches carry one, shape as `groupingPartialRetired-10881.test.ts`: absence per pack plus a presence control). No gate owes it; the console absence pin holds the behaviour, and because the dead-keys gate is blind to this namespace a key returning alone would be an unread, unnoticed row — harmless. Accepted as optional; the lane seat may ask for one, not a FAIL.
5. Deviation — comment-only edits to three sibling tests outside the literal "asserts the panel" surface: the deletion made their prose false, and the diff confirms no assertion or fixture change. Accepted.
6. Deviation — dead-keys verdict replaced by a hand census: the census is re-derived independently in ① item 2 and agrees. Accepted.
7. Deviation — ablation by restoring the page's base blob rather than `ablation-replace.mjs`: the base blob is exactly "the panel back, gated as it was", and console tests import the app's source, so no dist sits between. Accepted; ① item 6 reaches the same conclusion without a run.
8. Deviation — `Clause-②` line spelled per the PM addendum: matches what was read on both carriers. Accepted.
9. Deviations — model-free commit trailers; shared-checkout fetch with a named probe ref deleted afterwards; REST GETs instead of the payload channel: none touches this face or leaves residue in the diff. Noted.
10. `Fixes #12490` is the intended closure (the re-pointed card delivers exactly this deletion); no other card number in the PR body sits behind a closing keyword.

Nothing to escalate.
